roles.name: System Administrator
roles.description: Administers identities, authorization, system configuration, and controlled recovery.

roles.name: Operations Manager
roles.description: Approves operational transitions, reviews DEUR evidence, and closes Rentals without financial authority.

roles.name: Dispatcher
roles.description: Plans customers, projects, rentals, assignments, and dispatch activity.

roles.name: Equipment Coordinator
roles.description: Maintains fleet records, availability, assignment coordination, and equipment state.

roles.name: Operator
roles.description: Views only own assignments, equipment, shifts, and DEUR history and creates, saves, and submits own DEUR evidence.

roles.name: Billing Officer
roles.description: Performs billing, collections monitoring, financial reporting, and commercial-terms review without operational approval authority.

roles.name: Management Viewer
roles.description: Views executive and financial dashboards, KPIs, and approved report exports without transaction authority.

roles.name: Maintenance Staff
roles.description: Schedules and performs maintenance and updates related fleet condition.

roles.name: Auditor
roles.description: Reads auditable business and authorization evidence and exports approved redacted reports without transaction authority.
